subject: Marketplace pass-through payment responsibility matrix
messages:
From: Mark Robinson <mark.robinson@cloudmart.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Anna Choi <anna.choi@cloudmart.com>, legal@cloudmart.com
Date: 2027-03-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: clarify pass-through payment obligations (order form + MSA)

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo last week — CloudMart is excited to move forward. Legal asked me to surface two narrow but important asks on the marketplace/reseller addendum:

1) We need a clear, row-level payment responsibility matrix in the order form that allocates who invoices whom when fees are charged via the marketplace (CloudMart charged to end-customer vs. reseller charged).
2) CloudMart requires a pass-through clause confirming that Redwood will not re-invoice CloudMart for marketplace platform fees, and that any refund/chargebacks will be routed to the originating marketplace ledger.

I'm attaching a short spreadsheet with our suggested matrix and a markup of the addendum. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the two points as written, or if your legal team needs redlines? If redlines, please send back suggested language and list of internal approvers.

Attached: Payment_Responsibility_Matrix.xlsx; CloudMart_pass-through_suggested_redline.docx

Best,
Mark Robinson
Head of Partnerships, CloudMart
mark.robinson@cloudmart.com

From: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
To: Mark Robinson <mark.robinson@cloudmart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: clarify pass-through payment obligations (order form + MSA)

Hi Mark — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. I've looped in Marissa (legal lead on partnerships), Ben (sales lead on this deal), and Laura (finance) to help us triage. High-level responses below, next steps after internal review: 

- Matrix: the spreadsheet looks good as a starting point. We can adopt the row-level allocation but need to confirm currency/dispute flows for chargebacks — Laura, can you confirm if Redwood can accept chargeback routing to the marketplace ledger rather than invoicing CloudMart?
- Pass-through clause: Marissa, our initial thought is to accept a limited pass-through commitment but we need to preserve our right to bill if the marketplace fails to collect (narrow carveout). We'll propose specific redline language.

I'll get a quick redline from Legal by EOD tomorrow and a short operations note on how refunds/credits will be reconciled. If you have any limited examples of chargeback timing or settlement windows you rely on, please share.

Attachments (for our internal thread): Payment_Responsibility_Matrix.xlsx (from CloudMart); CloudMart_pass-through_suggested_redline.docx

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal-ops@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-26T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: clarify pass-through payment obligations (order form + MSA)

Team — quick legal triage after reading Mark's materials. Key points and proposed edits below. I'm also attaching a tracked-redline of the marketplace/reseller addendum.

Summary of concerns:
- We can accept a pass-through for platform fees, but we must include: (a) explicit carveout if the marketplace provider fails to remit (Redwood reserve to invoice CloudMart after 60 days), (b) limitation of liability tied to amounts actually collected by the marketplace, and (c) KYC/AML representation for end-customers to avoid fraud write-offs.
- The payment responsibility matrix is helpful; we should add a column for "chargeback window" (typical: 30–90 days) and "settlement cadence" (net-30 by marketplace).

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben/Jasmine: confirm commercial comfort with Redwood's 60-day remediation carveout (if marketplace does not remit).
2) Laura: validate accounting/AR flow; confirm whether Redwood can accept liability limited to collected amounts and provide mechanics for issuing credits back to CloudMart after reclaim.
3) I will circulate a redline (attached) with precise language for the MSA addendum and an exemplar order-form clause for the matrix.

Attachments: CloudMart_pass-through_redline.docx (tracked changes); Payment_Responsibility_Matrix_Redwood_notes.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Mark Robinson <mark.robinson@cloudmart.com>, CloudMart Legal <legal@cloudmart.com>
Date: 2027-03-27T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: clarify pass-through payment obligations (order form + MSA)

Thanks everyone — looping Mark/CloudMart back now with the proposed concurrent path. Short bullets for Mark: 

- Redwood can accept the pass-through concept subject to Marissa's carveout (60-day remediation if marketplace fails to remit).
- We propose adding the two columns Marissa suggested (chargeback window and settlement cadence) to the matrix; attached is our edited matrix for your review.
- If CloudMart is comfortable, we can move to a single round of negotiated redlines (Marissa's tracked doc) and then routing for signature.

Mark — attaching Payment_Responsibility_Matrix_Redwood_notes.xlsx and CloudMart_pass-through_redline.docx (Marissa's tracked). Please confirm whether the 60-day carveout is acceptable and any operational constraints on chargeback timing.

—Ben Carter
Head of Channel Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Payment_Responsibility_Matrix_Redwood_notes.xlsx; CloudMart_pass-through_redline.docx
